The technical sheet publishes typical T6/T651 values of 310 MPa ultimate tensile strength, 276 MPa yield strength, 207 MPa ultimate shear strength, 97 MPa reversed-stress fatigue endurance at 5 x 10^8 cycles, 68.3 GPa elastic modulus and 2.70 Mg/m^3 density. These are **typical values, not procurement minima or design allowables**.

The engineering-plate sheet lists 6061-T651 general-engineering plate from 0.250 in / 6.35 mm through 10.000 in / 254 mm and describes low residual stress and flatness as product characteristics. It does not establish availability of a particular stock size, certificate, lot, machining tolerance, or Project Button application acceptance.

R105 specifies certified ASTM B209 6061-T651 plate and requires a material certificate. The design screen uses a project-allocated 240 MPa yield basis, below Kaiser's 276 MPa typical value; that allocation is not a claim that Kaiser or ASTM guarantees 240 MPa for the eventual received lot. Qualified review and certificate verification remain mandatory.
